'''''The Galactic Rim on 100 Credits A Day''''' was a publication that served as a travel guide detailing various localities in the area of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Galactic Rim/Legends|Galactic Rim]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
